gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-choras: Stencil-cut and loud, Snowburst One shouts from the top with tall lowercase and wide bridges. Noto Sans Chorasmian settles in below, its curves stopping short of closing and its generous x-height keeping a long run of text easy going.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-cuneif: Noto Sans Cuneiform reads open and friendly, its e letting the light in and its lowercase swollen like glass beads. Snowburst One, with its stencil bridges, handles the shouting above it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-devana: Stencil bridges, tall lowercase, zero shyness: that is Snowburst One. Noto Sans Devanagari follows with a compact skyline where capitals melt into lowercase, so a long passage moves along smoothly, with an open-bottomed g for a little personality.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-glagol:
Snowburst One looks like a cut stencil sheet, tall and loud.

Noto Sans Glagolitic keeps its round, open letters sturdy and clear, so a long passage goes down easily after that headline.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-granth:
Expressive from its stencil bridges to its tall lowercase, Snowburst One makes the entrance, while Noto Sans Grantha follows with flat-bowled, open letters.

The strongest quality here is that sharp split between show and substance.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-gunjal: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi reads tall and chunky, its terminals cut back to leave a big gap. Snowburst One, stenciled and bold, sits above it and gives each page a loud opening line.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-gurmuk: Noto Sans Gurmukhi reads crisp, with outward-pointing terminals and ascenders barely clearing the x-height. And Snowburst One does what it does best: stencil bridges and tall lowercase make noise the body never tries to.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Stencil bridges between its letters make Snowburst One instantly recognizable. Noto Sans Hebrew then lets a deep midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems carry a long stretch of text comfortably.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian has big open eyes on every e and a, plus a deep middle band. Beside it, Snowburst One brings stencil boldness, so the body feels like the quiet answer to a shout.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kayah-: Stencil-sheet bold and tall, Snowburst One grabs attention first. Noto Sans Kayah Li stays quieter beneath it, brush ends lifting away before curves close, and capitals sitting barely above the lowercase.
